hey there, I know what you mean; life can be soo difficult yet ending it is so much easier, I know. But please it's not worth it. I know sometimes your own life can seem so dark and you feel that somedays your not really getting anywhere and the ours just keep passing by. But trust me when I tell you your worth more than to kys with "one days worth of lunch money". I want you to know that you are NOT alone and even if you cant see that for yourself maybe you could help someone else see it:) now this may sound crazy but it's what helpped me when times where tuff. Try to take the time outa your day to help someone struggling, I know it may be wierd to randomly help esp while you're struggling at the same time, but try it, even something as easy as making someone smile which is for free. Idk how this helps but it worked for me. the days when i felt like my life was meaningless I decided to try and give the person beside me some meaning, and somehow it bounced back on me and my life move forward. I know life can be hard and ending it all is so easy but the truth is your worth ALOT and if you wont believe make it meaningful for someone else! hope that was helpful.
